interpretation_limits: Both ratios and all three representations remain part of the comparison. Report full normalized trajectories, integrals, residual composition, access and descriptive seed variation.
Persistent numerical effects are retained; do not infer continuum error bounds, pure dimensionality, invariant curve order or mesh-independent residual predictions.
The coupled entry check is primarily compared with the fine grid. Common central-reference differences are a separate comparison.
In refined 5:1 entry versus 2D, integral differences have mixed signs across seeds while endpoint differences are positive. A universal reverse ordering is unsupported.
One paired saved-onset difference is present: refined 5:1 3D seed 2 enters the initial target hull at the 1 h saved bin versus 2 h in its paired baseline. The other 131 comparisons have equal bins.
The nine kinetic tests remain TE2 seed-0 conditional checks. Their completed review does not establish calibration or give resolution-independent effect estimates.
Busse et al. (2010), Supplementary Table S1, is not used as a numerical parameter basis.
